_comment: Closed Chinese theme/project titles for Laya Needs-you grouping. Product can edit titles, hints, and aliases here without code changes. Laya must pick from these lists; unknown/empty/garbage maps to nearest alias if confident, else 「其他」. Do not add English kebab slugs as titles.

themes.title: AI推进
themes.hint: company AI advance / lingee / 推进五态 — use AI推进, not ai-advance

themes.title: 日程/会议
themes.hint: calendar, 日程, meetings, schedule MCP — use 日程/会议, not Schedule Mcp or calendar

themes.title: 发布与发布流程
themes.hint: release, ship, rollout, 发布流程 — use 发布与发布流程, not release-process

themes.title: 产品缺陷
themes.hint: product bugs / 缺陷 — use 产品缺陷, not product-bug

themes.title: 其他
themes.hint: does not fit any other theme — keep the card, group under 其他

projects.title: 事元
projects.hint: personal ATOM / Desk / 事元产品

projects.title: 其他
projects.hint: no clear project — still keep the card
